facts.text: The resort is an all-inclusive hotel located in Playa Bávaro, Punta Cana.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a family vacation at this all-inclusive hotel located in Playa Bávaro.

facts.text: The resort has a water park called Aquazone with slides and splash zones.
facts.excerpt: Aquazone is the perfect place for kids and families to enjoy a world of aquatic fun in Punta Cana. Slides, splash zones and supervised activities

facts.text: The Kidsdom kids' program is designed for young people between 1 and 16 years old, with experiences adapted to each age.
facts.excerpt: with a program carefully designed for young people between 1 and 16 years old, with experiences adapted to each age.

facts.text: Guests get free and unlimited access to the Fun Republic Entertainment Park.
facts.excerpt: Benefit from free and unlimited access to this vibrant entertainment destination.

facts.text: The Family Concierge service offers personalized attention and access to exclusive areas.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy personalized attention, sophisticated amenities, and access to exclusive areas tailored for the most discerning guests.

facts.text: Family Concierge guests have a Destination Concierge available 24/7 for activity or restaurant bookings.
facts.excerpt: Our Destination Concierge will be on hand 24/7, ready to take care of all your activity or restaurant bookings, and offer you a private tour of the resort.

facts.text: Family Concierge perks include private check-in and check-out and a reserved beach area.
facts.excerpt: Reserved beach area

facts.text: Swim-Up Suites have a private solarium with whirlpool bathtub and direct access to the pool.
facts.excerpt: Private solarium with whirlpool bathtub, direct access to a magnificent pool, and spectacular views.

facts.text: The Suite has a terrace with a whirlpool bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to moments of relaxation on the terrace with a whirlpool bathtub.

facts.text: Sal is a modern steakhouse inspired by the work of Picasso, with a private room for celebrations.
facts.excerpt: A modern steakhouse, inspired by the work of Spanish artist Picasso, with a private room for celebrations.

facts.text: Tori is an Asian fusion restaurant with a sushi bar, robotayaki and teppanyaki tables.
facts.excerpt: enjoy live cuisine with the best sushi bar, robotayaki and teppanyaki tables in Punta Cana.

facts.text: Lemon Fish is a Peruvian cevichería serving ceviches, tiraditos, pokes and tartares.
facts.excerpt: Try signature ceviches, tiraditos, pokes, and delicious tartares at Playa Bávaro.

facts.text: Agua Marina by Leandro Díaz combines Caribbean flavors with contemporary cuisine in a beachfront setting.
facts.excerpt: Discover a restaurant where the flavors of the Caribbean meet contemporary cuisine in an elegant beachfront setting.

facts.text: Mama & Juana is a poolside cocktail bar with daily performances, named after the Dominican drink Mama Juana.
facts.excerpt: The popular Dominican drink Mama Juana gives its name to this magnificent poolside venue.

facts.text: YHI Spa's services are certified by Wellness for Cancer.
facts.excerpt: Our services are certified by Wellness for Cancer.

facts.text: The Cocotal Golf and Country Club is a 27-hole course designed by Pepe Gancedo.
facts.excerpt: Pepe Gancedo, 6-time Spanish champion and considered the Picasso of golf course design, is behind this 27-hole course

facts.text: The Rafa Nadal Tennis Center offers tennis and padel with coaches certified in the Rafa Nadal methodology.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Rafa Nadal Tennis Center in Punta Cana. Certified coaches follow the Rafa Nadal methodology, focused on hard work, improvement, and fun.

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, with a program designed for dogs; guests should contact the hotel to check conditions.
facts.excerpt: If you wish to stay with your pet, please contact the hotel to check conditions and manage your booking.

facts.text: The hotel is 16.8 km from Punta Cana International Airport.
facts.excerpt: 16,8 km fromPunta Cana International Airport

facts.text: Destination Inclusive experiences include a mofongo cooking class for Family Concierge guests.
facts.excerpt: Learn how to prepare mofongo, one of the country’s most iconic dishes, using traditional local ingredients.

facts.text: The hotel has a private beach.
facts.excerpt: - Private beach

facts.text: The hotel holds AAA 4 Diamond certification.
facts.excerpt: AAA 4 Diamond Certification
